lines: Embodied patience like compassion like taken body; support like having form of good character; renunciation essence ripeness like full; principle meaning jewel radiant state ascending earth.
l4.sanskrit_cite: mūrtā kṣameva karuṇeva gṛhītadehā dhāreva vigrahavatī śubhaśīlatāyāḥ vairāgyasāraparipākadaśeva pūrṇā tattvārtharatnarucirasthitirohaṇorvī
